rows.title: Repo-scoped read-only deploy key
rows.revocation: delete the deploy key via GitHub API; post-revocation access mechanically fails
rows.auditability: high — one key id, one repo, create+delete recorded; fingerprint bound
rows.setup_burden: low (FounderGate creates/deletes the key; founder does nothing)
rows.proves: read-only intake against founder-owned sandbox (with limits)

rows.title: Fine-grained Personal Access Token (read-only contents)
rows.scope: selected repos, Contents:read only; no write, no workflow, no org-wide
rows.revocation: revoke/delete the token in GitHub settings; expiry enforced
rows.auditability: medium — token is account-level; scope must be verified, value never printed
rows.setup_burden: medium (founder mints + pastes a token out-of-band; never into chat)
rows.next_gate: FOUNDER: authorize a fine-grained PAT proof on the sandbox (separate gate)

rows.title: GitHub App installation (read-only contents)
rows.scope: one installation, Contents:read; short-lived installation tokens
rows.revocation: uninstall the app / revoke installation; installation tokens expire (~1h)
rows.auditability: high — installation id + permission set + audit log
rows.setup_burden: medium-high (create + install an app; per-repo permission grant)
rows.next_gate: FOUNDER: authorize a GitHub App read-only proof on the sandbox (separate gate)

rows.title: Founder-uploaded archive (no live credential)
rows.scope: none — founder hands over a snapshot archive out-of-band
rows.revocation: n/a (no standing credential); archive is deleted after intake
rows.auditability: high — exact archive digest bound; no network access
rows.next_gate: FOUNDER: authorize an uploaded-archive intake proof (separate gate)

rows.title: Customer-controlled relay (customer runs the read on their side)
rows.scope: none held by FounderGate — the customer controls their own credential
rows.revocation: customer-side; FounderGate never holds the credential
rows.auditability: depends on the customer relay contract (future)
rows.next_gate: FOUNDER + CUSTOMER: define the relay contract (separate future gate)

rows.title: Existing valuable founder private repo (read-only)
rows.scope: a real, valuable founder repo — NOT a synthetic sandbox
rows.revocation: per chosen route (deploy key / PAT / App), but higher blast radius
rows.next_gate: TRUE FOUNDER GATE: explicitly authorize one real founder repo (read-only)

rows.title: Customer private / production repo (read-only)
rows.next_gate: TRUE FOUNDER GATE: explicit founder + customer authorization

recommended_next_gate.gate: FOUNDER: authorize a fine-grained PAT proof on the sandbox (separate gate)
